research_boundary: Research infrastructure for in silico materials science discovery. Outputs are research artifacts. No regulatory certification claims. No clinical or human-subject use. ITAR / weapons applications are out of scope (Meta UMA Acceptable Use Policy and operator policy).
_note: Synthetic L2 envelope. The single high-level falsifier target is 'high_disagreement' (PRD §L2: hard reject if energy disagreement > 75 meV/atom). The energy_disagreement value of 95 meV/atom triggers the hard-reject gate. force_rmse_disagreement_eV_per_Ang = 0.10 is intentionally between the promote gate (0.15) and hard-reject (0.35) thresholds so it does NOT add an independent fail; only the energy disagreement is the load-bearing failure.
